edited: Work out each patient's hemoglobin-to-hematocrit (`HGB`/`HCT`) ratio based on their lab tests. Keep the patients whose ratio is above the average across all patients, noting how far above they are. Then, within that group, keep those who are also above the group's own average, noting how far above that they are. Give one row with the averages, over these final patients, of the ratio, the amount above the overall average, and the amount above the group average, unrounded. queries:
WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM above_overall
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(a.above_overall) AS average_above_overall,
    AVG(a.ratio - g.avg_ratio) AS average_above_group
FROM above_overall AS a
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE a.ratio > g.avg_ratio

WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT p.ratio, p.ratio - o.average_ratio AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.average_ratio
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM above_overall
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(a.above_overall) AS average_above_overall,
    AVG(a.ratio - g.average_ratio) AS average_above_group
FROM above_overall AS a
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE a.ratio > g.average_ratio

WITH latest_paired AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        HGB / HCT AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT <> 0
),
patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ratio
    FROM latest_paired
    WHERE rn = 1
),
overall_benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg
    FROM patient_ratios
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT
        p.ratio,
        p.ratio - o.overall_avg AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg
),
group_benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS group_avg
    FROM above_overall
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    AVG(a.above_overall) AS avg_above_overall,
    AVG(a.ratio - g.group_avg) AS avg_above_group
FROM above_overall AS a
CROSS JOIN group_benchmark AS g
WHERE a.ratio > g.group_avg

WITH paired_tests AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        HGB / HCT AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date) AS test_rank
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT <> 0
),
patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ratio
    FROM paired_tests
    WHERE test_rank = 1
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT
        p.ratio,
        p.ratio - o.average_ratio AS above_overall_average
    FROM patient_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.average_ratio
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM above_overall
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(a.above_overall_average) AS average_above_overall,
    AVG(a.ratio - g.average_ratio) AS average_above_group
FROM above_overall AS a
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE a.ratio > g.average_ratio
